Requirements You're holding a grenade.

You attempt to slip a grenade onto a foe, then slip away before it blows. Attempt a @Check[thievery|against:perception] check against an adjacent creature's Perception DC, then you Stride.

Critical Success The grenade explodes after you Stride. The target treats the result of its saving throw as one degree of success worse.

Success The grenade explodes after you Stride.

Failure The grenade explodes after you Stride, but the target notices your actions. The target treats the result of its saving throw as one degree of success better.

Critical Failure The grenade explodes before you Stride, catching you in the blast.
